segments.text: THY will be doone in earth as it is in heauen.

The wil of god, ſignifieth, 1 The commandement of god. Pſal. 103.21. Yee his ſeruants that do his will. 2 It ſignifieth euents, or rather gods decree concerning future euents, Mat. 26.39. Not as J will, but as thou wilt. Iſa. 46.10. My counſell ſhall ſtand, And I will doe whatſoeuer I will. Thy will bee doone; that is, Cauſe that vve men may doe thy vvill, and obey thee.
The ſpecial Queſtions in this petition.
